legacy.text: Skip to main content CrowAgent Products Pricing Blog FAQ About ⌘K Sign in Request access HOME › COMPARE HONEST COMPARISONS Compare CrowMark with UK bid software Side-by-side, sourced comparisons of CrowMark against the tools UK suppliers shortlist. Real feature tables, our published pricing, and a dated source for every competitor figure. CrowMark is a UK bid and tender management suite from £49 per month. Where a rival does not publish a figure, we mark it Not published rather than guess, and we concede the points where CrowMark is not the strongest option. Pick a comparison below. CrowMark serves both sides of a procurement: CrowMark for Suppliers answers tenders, RFPs and questionnaires, and CrowMark for Buyers locates the evidence for each published requirement across the responses received. Both work in the public sector and the private sector. Supplier plans are published; buyer engagements are scoped to the organisation, so they are quoted rather than listed. The comparisons below are supplier-side, because that is where the competing tools sit. The daily UK tender feed in CrowMark, shown with a sample account. The notices themselves are genuine published Find a Tender and Contracts Finder records. ENTERPRISE ENGINE CrowMark vs AutogenAI Published SME pricing against a venture-backed enterprise engine that quotes on request. Where scale wins and where it does not. READ COMPARISON → UK DRAFTING PLATFORM CrowMark vs mytender.io Two UK-built tools. Figure-grounding and published pricing against a private-cloud drafting platform with content-tool integrations. READ COMPARISON → SOFT-FM SPECIALIST CrowMark vs CleanTender A sector-agnostic suite against a soft-FM specialist. Both publish pricing, so the question is scope and depth. READ COMPARISON → PER-BID SERVICE CrowMark vs SwiftBid Subscribe, or pay per bid. Which model fits depends on how often you bid. The break-even, worked through. READ COMPARISON → DECIDE FASTER. Published pricing from £49/month. Access is limited and offered by request.
